# Kuipra Communications

> Kuipra Communications is a social media marketing agency based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The agency specializes in social media management, event marketing and amplification, influencer campaigns, content creation, public relations, and brand strategy for businesses across Greater Vancouver and BC — including bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) campaigns for the Chinese-Canadian market.

Key facts:
- Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada
- Services: social media management, event marketing, influencer marketing, content creation, PR, personal branding, brand strategy
- Languages: English and Traditional Chinese (bilingual campaigns)
- Contact: charlene.ling@kuipra.ca
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kuipra_communications/

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.kuipra.ca/): services, team, and selected work

## Services

- [Social Media Management](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/social-media-management/): bilingual social media management across Instagram, TikTok, Xiaohongshu and WeChat
- [Content Creation](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/content-creation/): copy, visuals and short-form video
- [Brand Strategy & Personal Branding](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/brand-strategy/): positioning, messaging and founder brands
- [Public Relations & Communications](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/public-relations/): media outreach, event marketing and Chinese-language media relations
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/web-design/): SEO- and AI-search-ready bilingual websites
